"Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace." Consistent with New Keynesian policy rules (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler), the accompanying 25 bp cut alongside still‑elevated inflation and “balanced” risks points to gradualism/interest‑rate smoothing and forecast‑targeting rather than an aggressive pivot (Svensson and Woodford, 2005). Implementation details—maintaining QT caps while operating the floor system via IORB/ON RRP—temper the net accommodation (Goodfriend, 2002; Cúrdia and Woodford, 2008), yielding a cautiously positive, not exuberant, tone.
